name: VAULTPOD: Full-Body Immersion Arcade Network
description: A sprawling chain of full-body immersion pod arcades anchored in Tier 2-3 transit hubs, offering 400+ licensed scenario libraries ranging from corporate-sponsored fantasy epics to pirated the Gray Zone-origin survival runs. Each pod seals the user in haptic gel suspension with BCI-direct sensory override, dissolving the distinction between body and simulation for up to six hours. Competitor pods are arranged in mirrored arrays for group play, and the annual VAULTPOD Invitational draws cross-tier audiences via feed broadcast.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 pod technician discovers one of the pods has been running an unlicensed scenario that records users' emotional response data and sells it to a Spire behavioral analytics firm.
A character's estranged parent left behind a custom-authored VAULTPOD scenario as a form of posthumous message — but the scenario keeps updating as if someone is still writing it.
A competitive VAULTPOD team from the Gray Zone qualifies for the corporate-sponsored Invitational and must navigate Tier 3 social hostility while something is hunting them inside the simulation.
